mathematical_contract.slice_proposals: Exact rational specializations and signed maximal minors only propose bilinear slice factors. Exact Hypersolve division remains the authority for accepting each slice divisor.
mathematical_contract.quartic_extension: The single rational multi-affine factor package now accepts axis coefficient counts four and five. It proves one linear-axis factor and returns the exact cubic quotient; it does not introduce a degree-specific quartic assertion path.
mathematical_contract.first_taylor_lift: For each retained-coordinate orientation and bounded anchor, the translated first-order slice derives the relative top-slice scale when the selected slice factor is simple. The full first-Taylor search is exhausted before any repeated-factor work.
mathematical_contract.projective_alignment: For proved slice factors A and B at lift anchors a and b and a proved highest-lift factor T, exact alignment solves s_b*B-s_a*A-(b-a)*s_t*T=0. A nonzero right-null vector is accepted only after all four bilinear coefficients satisfy the relation exactly and both required scales are nonzero.
mathematical_contract.full_division_authority: Every reconstructed candidate is normalized and accepted only when it divides the complete original trivariate tensor exactly. Specializations, roots, minors, Taylor slices, and projective alignment cannot assert a global factor by themselves.
mathematical_contract.repeated_cubic_rejection: A genuine repeated cubic makes its discriminant relation vanish identically. Any exact nonzero value at the five bounded probes safely rejects that path; zero at every probe makes no positive claim and falls through to the existing exact invariant and division authority.
mathematical_contract.selected_sign: The verified linear factor and exact cubic quotient enter the same bounded recursive sign authority. A selected zero factor proves the product zero; decided nonzero signs multiply exactly.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: Dimensions are checked and all bivariate products and reconstructed tensors retain the 16384-control ceiling. The recursive split budget is three, sufficient for the supported quartic decomposition and no higher.
mathematical_contract.policy: A supportable rational quartic factorization is Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. The quintic control remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and returns Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records Approximate512Consumed.
mathematical_contract.failure: Missing exact rational roots, unresolved exact signs, failed slice or full-tensor division, degenerate scale relations, unsupported coefficient towers, resource overflow, or exhaustion of the three-split budget makes no exact claim and falls through to the shared policy terminal. No tolerance, sampled positive assertion, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: The product of the selected-zero square-free cubic fixture and a positive coupled multi-affine factor was unsupported. STRICT returned Predicate uncertainty and APPROXIMATE_512 consumed its terminal.
capability.source_revision: One rational multi-affine quartic factor is reconstructed from exact slice divisors, lifted by the simple or repeated-factor authority, proved by exact full-tensor division, and recursively signed with its cubic quotient.
capability.certified_fixture: The formerly terminal quartic rational three-field fixture returns Certified Zero under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512; neither policy consumes the approximate terminal.
capability.differential_factor_coverage: Four distinct dense multi-affine factors reconstruct on every axis; F^2*G^2 multiplicity reconstructs on every axis; one rational factor is recovered with a cubic cofactor; specialization degree drop and constant-root recovery remain supported; an unfactored quartic is rejected.
capability.remaining_policy_control: Multiplying the exact quartic fixture by another positive coupled factor makes every axis quintic. The bounded package deliberately declines it; STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 returns Zero only with Approximate512Consumed.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Recover bounded quintic factors or construct another exact selected-root relation only after axis content, linear resultant, binary selected-root, quadratic, repeated-cubic, rational square-free-cubic, and rational quartic paths fail.
